title: Huayu-Global: Skillful real-time quasi-global precipitation retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.29213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite precipitation products face a persistent trade-off: real-time estimates are timely but less accurate, whereas the most reliable products are often released months after observation. This delay keeps high-quality precipitation information outside the decision window for flood warning and disaster response. Here we report Huayu-Global, a cross-constellation deep-learning system that combines three geostationary sensor streams from five satellites through a common retrieval framework and generates coherent quasi-global precipitation fields every thirty minutes. Across more than a million independent station records from two periods outside the training years, Huayu-Global improves event detection and precipitation-amount estimation relative to the real-time products evaluated and reaches delayed-product-level skill in key metrics. translated_title: 华雨-全球：高精度实时准全球降水反演
translated_abstract: 卫星降水产品长期面临一个两难困境：实时估计虽然及时但精度较低，而最可靠的产品往往在观测后数月才发布。这种延迟使得高质量降水信息无法进入洪水预警和灾害响应的决策窗口。本研究报告了华雨-全球，这是一个跨星座深度学习系统，通过统一的反演框架融合来自五颗卫星的三种静止轨道传感器数据流，每三十分钟生成连贯的准全球降水场。在来自训练年份之外两个时期、超过一百万条独立站点记录的评估中，华雨-全球相对于所评估的实时产品改进了降水事件检测和降水量估计，并在关键指标上达到了延迟发布产品的精度水平。因此，华雨-全球将业务化静止轨道观测转化为及时、高精度的降水信息。
tldr: 华雨-全球是一个跨星座深度学习系统，融合五颗卫星的静止轨道传感器数据，每30分钟生成一次准全球降水场，在保持实时性的同时达到了延迟发布产品级别的精度。
en_tdlr: Huayu-Global is a cross-constellation deep learning system that fuses geostationary sensor data from five satellites to generate quasi-global precipitation fields every 30 minutes, achieving delayed-product-level accuracy while remaining real-time.
